description.value: The Life Building (formerly the UBC Student Union Building) is the main hub of student life at UBC Vancouver, operated by the Alma Mater Society — Canada's largest student union. It houses multiple food venues, shops, services, bookable study rooms, and event spaces spread across a purpose-built facility at the heart of the UBC campus. Touring cyclists riding through the UBC endowment lands can use this as a central rest stop with access to food and services.
